description: Moves an existing page through its browser navigation history by direction, relative steps, a domain anchor, or a tagged history entry.

pageId.description: Page ID whose navigation history should be changed.

direction.description: Direction in which to search or move through navigation history.

domain.description: Optional hostname anchor, such as example.com; searches the nearest matching entry in the requested direction.

tag.description: Exact history tag to locate in the requested direction.

n.description: Relative number of entries; 0 means the oldest entry when going back or newest entry when going forward.

purpose.description: Describe why returning to or revisiting this navigation entry is needed for the task

purposeHint: Describe why returning to or revisiting this navigation entry is needed for the task
